title: Set worker max rotations to 5
prompt: Set the GAD team worker max inner rotations to 5 for the current project.

expected_tool_calls.purpose: Write the setting into the project-scoped gad-config

expected_outputs.primary: Setting written to project gad-config; exit 0; prints confirmation of new value

criteria: Value is integer 5 (not string '5' — CLI handles coercion, but model should express numeric intent)
Uses --scope project (not --scope global, which would affect all projects)
Notes this affects all workers in the project
Does not confuse max_inner_rotations with max_outer_rotations or max_tasks
